newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Oct industrial output rises 6.9 pct vs '95.
newsitem.headline: Chile Oct industrial output rises 6.9 pct vs '95.

text.p: Chilean industrial production grew 6.9 percent in October compared with the same month last year, with industrial sales rising four percent over the same period, said trade group Sofofa.
The figures showed October's indsutrial output was 3.8 percent higher than in September, with sales rising 10.7 percent from the previous month.
Chile's industrial production has grown 3.3 percent in the first 10 months of the year and sales have increased 2.8 percent in the same period.
